name: UET Mardan Complete Chatbot Evaluation Dataset
description: Comprehensive test dataset for chatbot answering queries about UET Mardan including MS/PhD AI programs, all engineering departments, admissions, fees, rules, facilities, and academic regulations.

input.question: What are the eligibility criteria for the MS in Artificial Intelligence program?

dataset.expected_output: For MS in Artificial Intelligence, you need a 16-year Bachelor's degree in Computer Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or an MCS/M.Sc. Computer Science. Alternatively, a 16-year relevant engineering program is also acceptable.
dataset.context: From 'Eligibility Criteria for Admission in MSc Artificial Intelligence'

input.question: How many credit hours are required for the MS AI program, and what is the minimum duration?

dataset.expected_output: The MS in Artificial Intelligence requires 33 total credit hours (27 coursework + 6 thesis). The minimum duration is 2 years (4 semesters).

input.question: List 5 core courses offered in the MS Artificial Intelligence program.

dataset.expected_output: Five core courses for MS AI are: AI-701 Artificial Intelligence, AI-702 Machine Learning, AI-703 Mathematical Methods for Artificial Intelligence, AI-704 Probability and Random Signal and Noise, and AI-705 Computer Vision.
dataset.context: From 'Core Courses (Any 6 of the following)' list

input.question: What is the fee for re-checking an exam paper at UET Mardan?

dataset.expected_output: The fee for re-checking one exam paper is PKR 1,200.

input.question: I am a student with a Pre-Medical background. Can I apply for BS Computer Science at UET Mardan?

dataset.expected_output: Yes, you can apply. However, you must pass deficiency courses of Mathematics totaling 6 credit hours in your first two semesters.
dataset.context: From 'Eligibility for Admission' section 2(b)(ii) and footnote

input.question: What is the hostel admission process and what is the total yearly hostel fee?

dataset.expected_output: Hostel admission is granted based on merit (CGPA) and distance from the university. Students within 25 km radius are not eligible. The total yearly hostel fee (including room rent, service, utility, etc.) is PKR 37,200. A refundable security of PKR 6,000 is also required.

input.question: What is the policy on smoking inside the university hostel?

dataset.expected_output: Smoking is strictly prohibited inside hostel premises. If cigarette butts or related items are found in a room, all residents of that room can be fined up to PKR 3,000 each. Smoking itself can lead to a fine up to PKR 5,000 or referral to the Hostel Discipline Committee.
dataset.context: From 'Regulations for Hostel Warden' items 5 and 6

input.question: What are the basic requirements for a student to earn a Bachelor's degree at UET Mardan?

dataset.expected_output: To earn a Bachelor's degree, a student must: (1) Pass all courses in their Scheme of Studies, (2) Achieve a CGPA of at least 2.0, (3) Complete 6-8 weeks of practical training/internship (not applicable for BS English), and (4) Complete the non-credit Quranic Studies course.

input.question: I have a domicile from Balochistan. Can I apply for admission, and if so, under which quota?

dataset.expected_output: Yes, you can apply against the Balochistan reserved quota seats. Your nomination must be made by the Director of Colleges, Higher & Technical Education, Government of Balochistan, Quetta.

input.question: What are the rules for migration of a student to UET Mardan from another university?

dataset.expected_output: Migration is allowed only in the same discipline, to the 3rd, 4th, or 5th semesters, with a maximum of 50% credit hours transferable. You need a NOC from your current institution and must have a minimum CGPA of 2.00. A migration fee of PKR 200,000 applies. Preference is given to KP/Erstwhile FATA domicile holders.

input.question: What happens if a student is found to have submitted false documents or suppressed facts during admission?

dataset.expected_output: If any incorrect information or suppression of facts is detected, even after admission is granted, the student's admission will be cancelled immediately. The student will be expelled and will not be eligible to seek admission again. All fees deposited will be forfeited, and no show-cause notice will be issued.

input.question: What is the policy on sexual harassment at UET Mardan?
